correctness.rationale: Headline refutation (A) is a complete exact proof, independently replayed: psi0(x)=x tensor I12 in M24(C(Q)) is a unital *-homomorphism (W1 exact 24x24 Fraction identities: e11*e12=e12, e12*e22=e12, e21*e12=e22, psi0(e11)*psi0(e22)=0, psi0(e11)+psi0(e22)=I24), hence c.p.c. order-zero; [psi0(eij), z_l I24]=0 exactly for all matrix units and all diagonal scalars (W2, mesh-independent algebra), so 1/16-hypothesis holds with defect 0; every trace on B3 is tau_mu(a)=int (1/24)Tr(a(q)) dmu, so on constants tau=ntr and tau(psi0(e11))=tau(psi0(e22))=1/2 for ALL tau, max defect 0 < 1/16 (W3). Literal (D) is therefore FALSE. Generalization (B) is likewise proved: every t_k=(k+1)! is even, psi_k(x)=x tensor I_{t_k/2} is unital, exactly scalar-central, zero trace defect (W4). Pullback-mass law (C) core is exact combinatorics, replayed: M(l,K)=prod(i+2)=(K+1)!/(l+1)!, all-coordinate count prod(i+1)=K!/l! giving mass (l+1)/(K+1), first-point-at-m count (m!/l!)((K+1)!/(m+2)!) giving mass (l+1)/((m+1)(m+2)), partitions verified 24+20+10+6=60 at (1,4) and 120+120+60+36+24=360 at (1,5), single-path mass 1/M=(l+1)!/(K+1)!. Unique-trace/K0 arithmetic (D) U1-U3 is exact: R(l,K)=(l+1)/(K+1) telescoping, class sums 1-R, K0 colimit(Z,x(k+2))=Q with consistent pairing. Distinguished proof from illustration: W1-W4 and count/mass identities are proofs; E5 atom-split demo (10 paths -> 6 atoms on {0,1}^4 truncation) and U4 decoherence counts (11/11 steps >=0.5 in replay vs 0/19 at tol 0.125 in text) are mesh-model illustrations, not theorems about Q; full limit unique-trace/simplicity and strict-comparison claims are explicitly NOT claimed (DRAFT Sec.7, limitations). With those honest disclaimers, what is claimed as proved is correct.
